turns.replyTail:
u
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
Load your cards into the main pocket area incrementally rather than all at once. To access a card, pull the pull tab to expose them, then fan them out manually while they remain partially inside the wallet.
Pro tip: place your two most frequently used cards at the very top and bottom of the stack for immediate access. Cash can be stored underneath the rear cash strap or folded inside with your cards.
